{{Quote|You there! Stop! You can't do that!|Tal, to Darth Malgus|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
'''Tal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] who was working at a [[Unidentified Coruscant medical facility|medical facility]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the ending of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was in the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Eleena Daru]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]'s lover, was a patient at the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] at one point while Tal was on duty. When Malgus went to the facility to pick up Daru, Tal tried to stop him. A [[Unidentified nurse (Coruscant)|female nurse]] warned Tal that Malgus was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], so he relented and let Malgus leave with Daru.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tal appeared in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]] and first published on [[March 22]], [[2011]].
